name: Saddle Finance sUSDv2 metapool exploit and BlockSec whitehat rescue
race_type_reason: The rescue (block 14684434) came two blocks AFTER the attacker's attempt 2 reverted in 14684432 and replays that reverted attempt's exact swap amounts from a different address; no attacker tx is shown to be pending at 14684434 (attempt 3's contract was deployed 76 blocks later).
one_liner: BlockSec's whitehat replayed the attacker's reverted second attempt two blocks later (near-identical contract, same amounts), swept 1,356.73 WETH the attacker had left behind and returned all of it.

attacker.deploy_note: deploy of attack contract 2 (the reverted attempt the rescue replays); attack1/attack3 deploys: attack1 0x494b578bce7572e4fb8b1357ddf12754a28eec3439a62f6b14432dacda9cbb76 (block 14684300, idx 157), attack3 0x56cf6d3f402e521e3d8c369e4cc249a64c20b14eea47501ec82261f15e4a1475 (block 14684510, idx 170)

attack_txs.role: attempt 2: swap loop, reverted (out of gas on the final WETH transfer)
attempt 3: swap loop re-sized to the remaining pool, succeeded

attacker.attempt_amounts_note: attempt 1 took 3375.6729 WETH, attempt 3 took 557.0908 WETH (both received by 0x63341ba917de90498f3903b199df5699b4a55ac0); attempt 2 would have sent 1356.7285 WETH but its last WETH transfer ran out of gas and the tx reverted

bot.label: BlockSec whitehat rescue (Phalcon)
bot.note: contract deployed at idx 0 and called at idx 1 of the same block, both at 202.53 gwei gas price (179.6 gwei priority), no coinbase transfer

mempool_note: Pre-Merge incident (2022-04-30): mempool-dumpster starts 2023-08-07, Flashbots blocks API answers HTTP 410, so in-block evidence only; whether the rescue was a public-pool tx or a MEV-geth bundle cannot be told.

trigger.note: no mempool first-seen exists (pre-archive); the trigger BlockSec reports acting on is the already-mined reverted attempt 2 (0xd9bc83688e8eddde39bd9073c363665b1419d475dd4498e81b52cce41d7c76b3, block 14684432); BlockSec writes that its system 'spotted the failed transaction' (blocksec_saddle_rescue.html).

attacker_block_note: block of the attacker's reverted attempt 2 (idx 202, status 0), whose parameters the rescue replays; the rescue landed 2 blocks / 25 s later (bot block - attacker block = +2: the bot is AFTER the attacker). The attacker's attempt 1 (14684307) succeeded earlier and attempt 3 (14684518) succeeded 84 blocks after the rescue.

auction.bid_data_note: no bid history available for this block (pre-Merge or relays hold no data)

loot.gross_loot_method: WETH Transfer event pool-side holder -> rescue contract -> whitehat EOA in the rescue call receipt (1 WETH = 1 ETH)

captured_native.desc: WETH swept from the sUSDv2 metapool via the replayed swap loop and held by the whitehat EOA

loot.loot_note: scope = the rescue call only for gross/captured; priority_fee_paid_eth covers BOTH the contract deploy (idx 0, 0.352081 ETH) and the rescue call (idx 1, 0.325297 ETH) paid to the poolin.com fee recipient; bot_net = gross - priority fees (base-fee burn excluded) held BEFORE the return. Net is nominal: the whole amount was returned. USD figure not recomputed (BlockSec says ~$3.8M).

fate.returned_desc: 1356.7335721494 WETH, exactly the swept amount, sent by the whitehat EOA in 0x22efe4743cdbd6650e745e3e6ef4f611aa316e81b5b88d5413b0cd19205ab060 (block 14686088, 2022-04-30T14:22:29Z, about 6.6 h after the rescue). recipient 0xd186540fbcc460f6a3a9e705dc6d2406cbcc1c47 is a Gnosis Safe proxy (Etherscan getsourcecode: GnosisSafeProxy) that is NOT the metapool's owner (0x3f8e527af4e0c6e763e8f368ac679c44c45626ae); BlockSec states in its own words 'We returned all the rescued funds to Saddle Finance' (site/raw/web-saddle/blocksec_three_cases.html); on-chain ownership of the recipient Safe was not independently labelled.
fate.bounty_desc: no bounty retained: the returned amount equals the swept amount to the wei and no other WETH movement out of the whitehat EOA appears in saddle_rescue_tokentx.json; BlockSec bore the ~0.68 ETH gas premium. Any bounty agreed off-chain would not show here.
fate.public_statement: BlockSec: 'We returned all the rescued funds to Saddle Finance.' (blocksec.com 'how-blocksec-rescued-stolen-funds-from-technical-perspectives-of-three-representative-cases', saved)
fate.return_status_rule: returned = everything went back to the victim side except a bounty the victim agreed to or offered; partial = some came back, otherwise; none = known zero within the documented search window; unknown = unresolved

discrepancies: incident.json says the 'attacker's next attempt' (attempt 3, block 14684518) was NOT pending at 14684434; confirmed: its contract (0x797418a5) was deployed in block 14684510 (idx 170), 76 blocks after the rescue. No attacker tx is evidenced as pending at 14684434.
Attempt 2 tried to send 1356.728509 WETH; the rescue moved 1356.733572 WETH (difference 0.005063 WETH, pool state moved between the blocks; not investigated further).
REKT lists 0xe7e04747 (14684518, success) as the 'second hack tx'; it is attacker attempt 3. The failed second attempt is 0xd9bc8368 (14684432).
evidence_notes: Rescue call 0x9549c0cb48 (14684434 idx 1) and all three attacker swap-loop txs have 403 call frames, the same top selector 0xaf8271f7 and 9 metapool swaps; the rescue's 9 swaps carry the same (tokenIn, tokenOut, dx, minDy) words as attempt 2 (9/9 identical) and none of attempt 1's or 3's (0/9, 0/9) (recomputed from site/raw/rpc/trace_<tx>.json).

Attempt 2 (14684432 idx 202) reverted: execution reverted on the final WETH transfer with 'out of gas' (gas used 2,153,653), so its WETH stayed in the pool; the rescue (2 blocks later, poolin.com block, 202.5 gwei) swept it. Per incident.json the rescue contract's runtime differs from attacker contract 2 in only 20 bytes (not re-diffed here).

Attacker's own takes: attempt 1 3375.6729 WETH (14684307 idx 212), attempt 3 557.0908 WETH (14684518 idx 282); attempt 3's contract was deployed in 14684510, 76 blocks after the rescue, so nothing of the attacker's was pending at 14684434.

Only three txs on the metapool emitted the swap-loop event (attempt 1, rescue, attempt 3) in Etherscan logs for 14684000-14686500 (site/raw/etherscan/saddle_pool_logs_es.json); reverted copies leave no logs and were not enumerated.
Return: 0x22efe4743c at block 14686088 moves exactly 1356.7335721494 WETH out of the whitehat EOA (saddle_rescue_tokentx.json). In-block evidence only, no mempool.
